WHAT IS PROJECT MATRIX?
Prioritize R&D initiatives on an impact/effort matrix. Use Resources to plan team allocation and track costs. Use Org Chart to visualize reporting structure and plan headcount. Use Skill Risk to identify knowledge gaps and single points of failure.
